The diagonals of a rectangle bisect each other, so O=(a,b). Diagonal BD can be parameterized as B+t(D-B)=(2at,2bt). Line CE can be parameterized as C+s(E-C)=(2a(1-s),bs). Thus F is on BD at a distance from B equal to 1/3 of the whole BD, while O is on BD at a distance from B equal to 1/2 of the whole BD. Therefore FB=(1/3)BD, OF=(1/2-1/3)BD=(1/6)BD, so OF/FB=(1/6)/(1/3)=1/2.

From the text, use that E is the midpoint of AB and O is the midpoint of both diagonals of the rectangle. Set coordinates, for example B=(0,0), C=(2a,0), A=(0,2b), D=(2a,2b). Then E=(0,b) and O=(a,b). Parametrize BD by B+t(D-B)=(2at,2bt). Parametrize CE by C+s(E-C)=(2a(1-s),bs). Equating coordinates gives t=1-s and 2t=s, hence t=1/3.
